SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.LH_MACHINE_CODE, t.MATERIAL_CODE, t.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON, t.CLASS1_LH_NO, t.CLASS1_LH_TYPE, t.CLASS2_LH_NO, t.CLASS2_LH_TYPE, t.CLASS3_LH_NO, t.CLASS3_LH_TYPE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) AS schedule_day, LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_LH_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE), LH_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = latest.schedule_day AND t.LH_MACHINE_CODE = latest.LH_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.ORDER_NO, t.SCHEDULE_DATE, t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, t.CLASS1_UN_REASON, t.CLASS2_UN_REASON, t.CLASS3_UN_REASON, t.CLASS1_PERSON, t.CLASS2_PERSON, t.CLASS3_PERSON, t.EMBRYO_CODE, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) AS schedule_day, CX_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, SCHEDULE_DATE), CX_MACHINE_CODE, ORDER_NO ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) = latest.schedule_day AND t.CX_MACHINE_CODE = latest.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND t.ORDER_NO = latest.ORDER_NO AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.SCHEDULE_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) AND t.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND t.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}

SELECT t.FINISH_DATE, t.DAY_FINISH_QTY, t.EMBRYO_CODE, t.EXAMPLE_TYPE, t.BOM_DATA_VERSION, t.DATA_VERSION, t.COMPANY_CODE, t.FACTORY_CODE FROM MES_CX_DAY_FINISH_QTY t INNER JOIN ( SELECT CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE) AS finish_day, FACTORY_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION, MAX(DATA_VERSION) AS MAX_VERSION FROM MES_CX_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE, FINISH_DATE), FACTORY_CODE, EMBRYO_CODE, BOM_DATA_VERSION ) latest ON CONVERT(DATE, t.FINISH_DATE) = latest.finish_day AND t.FACTORY_CODE = latest.FACTORY_CODE AND t.EMBRYO_CODE = latest.EMBRYO_CODE AND t.BOM_DATA_VERSION = latest.BOM_DATA_VERSION AND t.DATA_VERSION = latest.MAX_VERSION WHERE CONVERT(DATE, t.FINISH_DATE) <= CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE())
SELECT DISTINCT DATA_VERSION FROM MOULD_CLEAN_PLAN WHERE DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} ORDER BY DATA_VERSION ASC

SELECT ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_TYPE, MACHINE_STOP_TYPE, BEGIN_DATE, END_DATE, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, DATA_VERSION, COMPANY_CODE, FACTORY_CODE FROM DEV_PLAN_CLOSE WHERE 1 = 1 AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND DATA_VERSION = #{dataVersion}
SELECT MAX(DATA_VERSION) FROM DEV_PLAN_CLOSE WHERE DATA_VERSION IS NOT NULL AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}
